svg.title: Pope Leo XIV votes by mail in the US midterms
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration: at sunset on a stone terrace beside the dome of St. Peter's Basilica, Pope Leo XIV in a white cassock and skullcap raises his arm to send off a sealed airmail envelope. A dotted flight path arcs from his hand over the curve of the Atlantic Ocean to a small Chicago skyline, with the Willis Tower and Hancock Center, on the far horizon. The envelope is blank and closed.
